summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a Philippine Stock Exchange disclosure dated October 5, 2026 providing an update on the planned VITRO REIT initial public offering. The registrant acts as filer/sponsor; the communication is explicitly not an offer to sell securities and none are being registered under the US Securities Act, with distribution restricted outside the Philippines. No stake, price per share, implied value, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. This is a routine IPO-process update, not a special situation; watch for eventual REIT pricing and asset-injection mechanics.
